issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition.constant.value[x] is a 1..1 choice of FHIR primitive types; FHIR dateTime with time uses the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss timezone form, and FHIR instant is a constrained dateTime requiring full date, time, seconds, and timezone.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe accepted invalid constants: valueDateTime='2016T12:00:00Z', valueDateTime='2016-11T12:00:00Z', valueInstant='2016T12:00:00Z', and valueInstant='2016-11T12:00:00Z'. Expected ParseError/ValueError before SQL generation because partial dates cannot carry a time component and instant must be a full dateTime with timezone.
issues.root_cause: The shared constant primitive validator used one broad dateTime regex for both dateTime and instant, then only checked that instant had a time and timezone. That allowed a time component to be attached to incomplete year or year-month dates such as 2024T00:00:00Z and 2024-01T00:00:00Z.
issues.resolution: Updated fhir4ds/viewdef/types.py so valueDateTime with a time component requires a complete YYYY-MM-DD date and timezone, and valueInstant requires complete date, time, and timezone. Added parser, Constant.to_dict(), and direct SQLGenerator dataclass regression tests; refreshed constants resolver documentation and ViewDefinition AGENTS notes.
